items.q: Do I pay one-time, monthly, or both?
items.a: Website packages are one-time build fees (Starter through Enterprise Multi-Site). Ongoing services — hosting, SEO, ads, content, maintenance — are monthly bundles or à la carte. Most clinics pair one build package with one monthly bundle. You'll always see the exact combined number in your written proposal.

items.q: What's included in the one-time build price?
items.a: Design, development, content structure, on-page SEO, integrations listed for that package, HIPAA-aware forms where applicable, launch, and the revision rounds specified. Nothing is billed hourly during the build — the quoted price is what you pay.

items.q: Do I have to buy a monthly bundle?
items.a: No. Monthly bundles are optional. You can stay on your own hosting and manage the site yourself, or pick individual add-ons à la carte. The bundles simply save money vs. buying each service individually.

items.q: Can I upgrade from Starter to Clinic Pro later?
items.a: Yes. Every package builds on the same design system, so upgrading is a credit-based scope change — you pay the difference plus any migration work. Nothing gets thrown away.

items.q: Do you own my site if I stop paying monthly?
items.a: You own your site regardless. Domain, brand assets, content, code, and database are yours. Stopping a monthly bundle stops the ongoing service; the site keeps running on whatever hosting you choose.

HIPAA-aware architecture is included on Clinic Pro and above. A signed Business Associate Agreement is included on Authority Brand and Enterprise Multi-Site, and available as an add-on for other packages where a form collects PHI.

items.q: What if I need something not listed?
items.a: Custom scopes — bespoke integrations, new feature builds, EHR sync, catalog imports — are quoted flat-fee after a scoping session. You'll always see a written scope and price before any work begins.

Website build work is refundable pro-rata until final launch approval. Monthly bundles are non-refundable for the current cycle but you can cancel any time with 30 days' notice — you'll never be billed for a month you didn't use.
